record.original_question: Given a set M of positive integers, call S⊆N an M-set if a,b∈S implies a−b∉M. Determine μ(M)=sup_S upper_d(S), where S ranges over all M-sets and upper_d(S) is the upper asymptotic density of S. The problem is especially open beyond known particular cases when |M|=3.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{N} = \{1, 2, 3, \dots\}$. For a nonempty set $M$ of positive integers, call a set $S \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ an $M$-set if for all $a, b \in S$ one has $a - b \notin M$. The upper asymptotic density of a set $S \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ is defined by
$$\overline{d}(S) = \limsup_{n \to \infty} \frac{|S \cap \{1, 2, \dots, n\}|}{n}.$$
Define
$$\mu(M) := \sup\{\overline{d}(S) : S \subseteq \mathbb{N} \text{ is an } M\text{-set}\}.$$
Determine $\mu(M)$ as an explicit function of $M$. In particular, give a closed-form (or otherwise effective) evaluation of $\mu(M)$ for every three-element set $M = \{m_1, m_2, m_3\}$ of positive integers.
artifact.status_search_result: Motzkin's problem of determining μ(M) is known to be solved for |M| ≤ 2 (Cantor–Gordon), with only partial results for |M| = 3 (e.g., families like {1, j, k} treated by Haralambis, Gupta–Tripathi, and others). Recent works (2020–2024) continue to give partial progress, and the general case |M| = 3 remains open.

status_evidence.title: On Optimal M-Sets Related to Motzkin's Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Studies particular three-element cases of Motzkin's problem, treating special families of M with |M|=3.
status_evidence.claim: The |M|=3 case is studied only in special families, indicating the general case remains open.

status_evidence.title: On sets with missing differences in compact abelian groups
status_evidence.snippet: For up to three missing differences, the Motzkin density in a compact abelian group is rational; general case unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial structural results exist but the explicit determination of μ(M) for general |M|=3 is not given.

status_evidence.title: Density of integral sets with missing differences
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys progress on μ(M); |M|≤2 solved, |M|=3 partial.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms open status of the general |M|=3 problem.
